text: Final categorization: OK (Justification: The paper presents a novel coupled model, LPJ-FLUS, whose primary objective is to simulate and predict future land use and land cover change (LUCC) across China—a national-scale study area. It implements two distinct SSP-RCP future scenarios (SSP1-RCP2.6 and SSP5-RCP8.5) with quantitative comparison of outcomes. The modeling approach is spatially explicit at 1 km resolution, includes mapped LULC projections for 2015–2100, and reports quantitative accuracy metrics (e.g., Figure of Merit, Pearson correlation coefficients) based on historical validation against MODIS data for 2010 and 2015. All core inclusion criteria are met, and none of the exclusion criteria apply: it is not global/local-only, includes LULC prediction as its central focus, provides spatial outputs, uses multiple future scenarios, and is applied at the national scale.)
